# Chewettes

> A food blog exploring cooking, dining, and shopping through personal essays, food history, and seasonal recipes with a focus on international cuisines and food traditions.

Chewettes is a personal food blog written by an Amazon Vine reviewer and food enthusiast with a family restaurant background. The site celebrates food holidays, cultural culinary traditions, and nostalgic food memories through well-researched historical posts and recipe explorations.

## Core Pages

- [Chewettes – Musings on cooking, dining, and food shopping](https://chewettes.wordpress.com): Homepage showcasing food blog with musings on cooking, dining, and shopping
- [About – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/about): Author bio: food enthusiast, Amazon Vine reviewer, restaurant family background

## Featured Food Essays & Recipes

- [Welcome – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2016/05/27/blog-post-title): Welcome post introducing blog about food passion and family restaurant heritage
- [Let's Go Green! – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/07/22/lets-go-green): Summer recipes featuring green sauces: chimichurri, gremolata, international herbs
- [Za'atar, Advieh, Baha-what? – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/zaatar-advieh-baha-what): Middle Eastern and Iranian spice blends for grilling and ethnic cuisine
- [More Moo Juice, Please? – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/02/23/more-moo-juice-please): Milk varieties, A2 milk, grass-fed organic, dairy products grocery shopping

## Food Holiday Posts

- [Muffins vs Cupcakes – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2018/02/20/muffins-vs-cupcakes): National Muffin Day article comparing muffins and cupcakes with baking methods
- [National Irish Coffee Day – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2018/01/25/national-irish-coffee-day): Irish coffee history and recipe from County Kerry, Ireland travel experience
- [National Popcorn Day – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2018/01/19/national-popcorn-day): Popcorn history from Mexico, Peru, New Mexico with personal cooking memories
- [Please pass the s'mores – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/08/09/please-pass-the-smores): S'mores product review of NutriChef marshmallow maker for indoor roasting
- [National Potato Chip Day! – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/03/14/national-potato-chip-day): Potato chip history: George Crum, Saratoga Springs, food origin trivia

## Cultural & Seasonal Celebrations

- [Hello, Summer! – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/06/21/hello-summer): Ice cream memories of Magnolia vendor, homemade ice cream, summer treats
- [Viva Mexico! – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/05/05/viva-mexico): Cinco de Mayo celebration with Mexican cuisine, enchiladas, cultural traditions
- [The Original Easter Egg – Chewettes](https://chewettes.wordpress.com/2017/04/15/the-original-easter-egg): Easter egg history from Eastern Europe, Ukrainian pyzanka folk art tradition
